reactor_type: 15-cm2 square-shaped lateral gas flux ALD chamber (ISAC research)
evidence: SiOx thin films were deposited on the Si substrate over a deposition temperature range of 80–200 °C using a 15-cm2 square-shaped lateral gas flux ALD chamber (ISAC research). The chamber pressure was held at 1.2 torr with 500 sccm of Ar purge gas.
